requiredFindings.title: Index recipe delta exceeds the declared paths/names/counts-only constraint
requiredFindings.evidence: Against prepare_sm_hierarchy_missing_public_indexes_r7.py, the index script replaces diagnostic parsing with eight-lock parsing and template-r116 archive membership analysis, records lock pins/lockedBy, and adds a per-locked-version checksum-presence assertion. These are new derivation, validation and receipt logic, beyond paths, names, counts and messages. The request expressly allows a packet total calculation but supplies no corresponding index-recipe exception.
requiredFindings.impact: The acquisition data and lock-derived names independently check out, but recipesDerivedOnlyByPathsCounts cannot truthfully be true under the stated constraint. The declared review scope understates the actual index variant.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Declare the lock-derived name selection, lock/template comparison, lock provenance receipt and locked-version/checksum validation as explicit index-recipe deltas in the request/report, with an appropriately scoped expected field, or provide a genuinely matching accepted parent. Preserve the already verified evidence and closed fetch/intake behavior. No new network acquisition, intake, test or corpus-resolution run is needed.
